name: email-get-thread
description: Fetch every message in an email thread, with full bodies, oldest first. Takes the threadId returned by email-list or email-get. Use this instead of calling email-get once per message.

inputs.thread_id: string (threadId of the thread to fetch, from email-list or email-get)
inputs.account: string? (named account to read from, as configured under Settings → Channels → Email → Email accounts. Defaults to the primary account.)

outputs.truncated: boolean (true when the thread exceeded the 50-message cap or the size budget; the oldest messages were left out, the newest are always included)
outputs.omittedOldest: number (how many of the oldest messages were left out)
outputs.messages: object[] (oldest first; each { id, threadId, subject, from, to, cc, body, date, unread, folders, attachments: [{ id, filename, contentType, size }] })
